justifications.evidence: each arm the done_when asks for is in the manifest and has its log (gate-base-60ecc274.log, gate-final.log, negative-control-final.log, suite-base.log, suite-final.log), with the only looseness that measurement_module and measurement_cwd are carried in the logs' header lines rather than as manifest keys, which the manifest audit accepts.
justifications.fit: report_read_failures and memoised_read follow the module's public-helper and docstring idiom around reckon/crew/review_records.py:567 and reuse the existing _READ_FAILURES region rather than introducing a second collection channel.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the delivered head passes the file the goal names in full (gate-final.log, 5 passed EXIT=0) and no other test file was changed to reach it.
justifications.reuse: memoised_read wraps the repository's memoisation owner file_memo.memoized_key instead of implementing a cache, _remember_failure at reckon/crew/review_records.py:582 is an extraction of the body that already stood in _note_skipped_record:583, and a search over reckon/ for a region-skip replay found only stream replay in reckon/crew/picker/replay.py, a different capability.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff — reckon/crew/review_records.py, reckon/crew/obligations.py, reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py, reckon/crew/recovery_memo.py and the fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/ — is inside a declared write path.
